subject: RM_Tarruq__faces

observed.facings.png: Three facings at one scale on a checkerboard. South: a hexapod creature seen from the front. It has a tall, hammer-shaped head crest with flanges to left and right, a small pointed snout pointing down, and a big ribbed rust-red sac hanging below the head. Jagged plates run along its back. It stands on six thin, jointed legs that end in splayed toes with dark pads. East: the same creature in true side profile, facing screen-right. The head is long and beak-like, the crest sweeps back and has an upward hook, and the ribbed throat sac bulges under the jaw. A row of jagged dorsal plates runs along the back, and six long legs end in splayed padded feet. The neck in east is carried forward and lower than in south. North: the rear. You see haunches, dorsal plates and the back of the head. The crest curls up and to one side. Two round lobes of the throat sac show on both sides of the neck, and six padded feet are visible. No face or eyes. The coat on every facing is a reticulated rust and cream pattern.
observed.south.png: Front view at full size. Crested head, centred toward the camera. A ribbed throat sac fills the chest under the head. Thin legs with splayed toes and dark grip pads. Clean alpha, painterly shading, a thin dark edge but no heavy keyline.
observed.east.png: Profile facing right. The head reaches forward with a hooked crest swept back. The ribbed throat chamber is clearly visible under the jaw. Dorsal plates run along the spine. Six long legs with wide padded toes, mid-stride. Clean alpha. Same palette and coat pattern as south.
observed.north.png: Rear view. Back, haunches and dorsal plates. The head is seen from behind, with the crest curling over to the upper left. The sac lobes stick out on both sides of the neck. No eyes or face. Splayed padded feet. Clean alpha.
observed.scale.png: At max zoom the creature stands about as tall as the vanilla human and is longer than the human. At 32 px per cell it reads as a small rust-coloured spindly shape. The legs are thin, but the body and crest still read against the ground.

SOUTH_FRONT.seen: South shows the head and throat sac facing the camera, with the legs splayed symmetrically.

NORTH_REAR.seen: North shows haunches, dorsal plates and the back of the head. No eyes or face.

NO_OVERHEAD.seen: All three facings are side-on, at the game-camera angle. None is overhead.

SAME_SIZE.seen: Leg length, foot size and body depth match across facings in facings.png. The 20% height spread comes from the pose: in east the neck and crest are carried forward and low, in south the crest is held upright.

SAME_ANIMAL.seen: East has the same reticulated rust and cream coat, six padded legs, dorsal plates, crested head and ribbed throat sac as south. The crest turns with the head: an upright spike with flanges from the front, a back-swept hook in profile.

SIGNATURE.seen: The deep ribbed throat chamber is large and legible on south and east. Lean, long climbing limbs are plain on every facing.

ALIEN.seen: Only the coat pattern is giraffe-like. Six legs, the hammer crest, the throat sac and the splayed padded toes keep anyone from naming it a giraffe.

DEPARTURES.seen: 1) grip-padded feet: present. Splayed toes with dark pads on all six feet, every facing. 2) a deep resonating throat-chamber: present. A ribbed sac under the jaw on south and east, and its lobes are visible from north.

STYLE.seen: Painterly shading and real-looking anatomy. No cute face, no flat cel shading, no heavy keyline.

OURS.seen: A unique invented hexapod design in a consistent house style. Not a vanilla or other-mod animal.

ALPHA.seen: Clean cut-out on all facings. No ground patch, shadow or backdrop.

OWNER_NOTES.seen: The new east facing shows the same individual as the accepted south: same coat, crest, sac, plates and six padded legs, seen from its own side.

SCALE.seen: About human height and a little longer than the human. That fits a lean, long-limbed creature with drawSize 1.3.

LEGIBLE.seen: At 32 px the rust body mass and the crest read as a distinct spindly shape against the ground. The legs thin out but stay visible.

reply.subject: RM_Tarruq__faces
reply.image_seen: Five panels show an orange, plated, long-legged alien with broad grip pads, a ribbed throat chamber and a hooked crest: shared-scale facings, individual south/east/north views, and a human scale comparison.

concerns.evidence: In facings.png, east carries its throat and crest forward over a nearly horizontal torso, while south and north carry the head above the torso. East's planted feet, long leg segments, foot pads and armor plates remain comparable in scale to south. The measured 209-versus-250 px height difference is consistent with this lower head carriage, rather than an overall size reduction.

The accepted south crest already has a hooked, left-curving apex above its broad lateral flanges; it is not a purely symmetric upright spike. North reveals more of that swept crest's side above an off-axis head, while showing the rear neck, overlapping back plates and haunches without eyes or a face. The changed crest silhouette is compatible with head orientation and does not establish different crest anatomy.

reasons: opus band WEAK (model said good); blocking ['F_SIZE_JUMP', 'F_INCONSISTENT']; polish ['LEGIB_32']
